request.style: English, Sacred Harp Christmas anthem, a raw loud four-part congregation in a hollow square, no instruments, rustic open harmonies, joyful accented downbeats, 3/4, 112 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The shepherds in the field by night
Were watching flocks of sheep
When glory shone with sudden light
And woke them from their sleep

[Verse]
Fear not, the shining angel said
Great joy to all I bring
In Bethlehem a manger bed
Now holds your Lord and King

[Verse]
And then a host of angels came
And filled the midnight sky
They sang the glory of his name
To God be praise on high

[Verse]
And peace on earth to all below
With whom the Lord is pleased
So let us all to Bethlehem go
And see what God has seized
